listening.title: At the Shop
listening.script:
Shopkeeper: Can I help you?
Lisa: Yes, I want an apple and a banana, please.
Shopkeeper: Here you are. That is two yuan.
Lisa: Thank you. Goodbye!
Shopkeeper: Bye!

questions.q: What does Lisa want to buy?
questions.explain: Lisa 说 I want an apple and a banana.
Shopkeeper 说 That is two yuan.

listening.title: Tom's Birthday
listening.script: Today is Tom's birthday. His mom makes a big cake. His friends come to the party. They sing a song and eat the cake. Tom gets a red toy car. He is very happy. He says, 'This is the best day!'

questions.explain: 原文 His mom makes a big cake.
原文 Tom gets a red toy car.

listening.title: After School
listening.script:
Mom: How was school today?
Ben: It was fun! We played football.
Mom: Did you finish your homework?
Ben: Not yet. I will do it now.
Mom: Good boy.

questions.q: What did Ben do at school?

questions.explain: Ben 说 I will do it now.

listening.title: Asking the Way
listening.script:
Tourist: Excuse me, how can I get to the train station?
Local: Go straight and turn left at the bank. Then walk for five minutes. You will see it on your right.
Tourist: Thank you very much!
Local: You're welcome.

questions.q: Where does the tourist want to go?
questions.explain: Tourist 问 how can I get to the train station.
Local 说 turn left at the bank.

listening.title: The Honest Boy
listening.script: Jack broke his neighbor's window with a ball. He was afraid, but he went to the neighbor and said sorry. The neighbor was not angry. He said, 'I like honest boys.' Jack helped fix the window. He felt proud of telling the truth.

questions.explain: 原文 broke his neighbor's window.
邻居说 I like honest boys.

listening.title: Making Plans
listening.script:
Anna: What are you doing this weekend?
Leo: I plan to visit the museum on Saturday.
Anna: Sounds great! Can I join you?
Leo: Sure! Let's meet at nine at the bus stop.
Anna: Perfect, see you then.

questions.q: What will Leo do on Saturday?
questions.explain: Leo 说 I plan to visit the museum on Saturday.
Leo 说 Let's meet at nine at the bus stop.

listening.title: A Job Interview
listening.script:
Manager: Why do you want this job?
Applicant: I have always been interested in teaching. I volunteered at a school last summer and loved it.
Manager: What is your strength?
Applicant: I am patient and good at explaining difficult ideas.
Manager: Good. We will call you next week.

questions.q: What job is the applicant applying for?
questions.explain: Applicant 提到 interested in teaching 和 volunteered at a school。

questions.q: What strength does the applicant mention?
options: Being patient and good at explaining
questions.explain: 原文 I am patient and good at explaining difficult ideas.

listening.title: The Unexpected Gift
listening.script: Emma saved money for months to buy a bike. On her birthday, her parents gave her the exact bike she wanted. She was surprised and cried happily. Later she learned her parents had secretly added money to her savings. Small acts of love often mean the most.

questions.q: What did Emma want to buy?
questions.explain: 原文 saved money for months to buy a bike.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the story?
options: Small acts of love mean the most
questions.explain: 结尾点题 Small acts of love often mean the most.

listening.title: Debating Homework
listening.script:
Student: I think homework should be less. We are too tired.
Teacher: Homework helps you remember what you learn. But it should not be too much.
Student: Then maybe short and useful homework is best?
Teacher: I agree. Quality matters more than quantity.
Student: That makes sense.

questions.q: What does the teacher think about homework?
options: It helps but should not be too much
questions.explain: Teacher 说 Homework helps you remember... but should not be too much.

questions.q: What do they agree on at last?
questions.explain: 结尾 Teacher 说 Quality matters more than quantity.
